aboutGame.title: What Is Build A Striker?
paragraphs: Build A Striker is a Roblox soccer game by Wild Card. and a fan-made tribute to Blue Lock. In each round, you roll a random team, receive a random player from that team, and add one of that player’s attributes to the striker you are building.

A full run lasts 10 rounds, with team rolls ranging from First Selection to Pros. Your picks can come from Shooting, Speed, Dribbling, Passing, Physical, Defense, Vision, IQ, Ego, and Weapon. The finished striker competes for a place on the leaderboard.

items.question: What is Build A Striker?
items.answer: Build A Striker is a Roblox soccer game by Wild Card. You roll a team and player, keep one player attribute each round, and build a striker over 10 rounds.

items.question: How many rounds are in Build A Striker?
items.answer: A full Build A Striker run has 10 rounds. Each round adds one chosen attribute to your striker before you compete on the leaderboard.

items.question: Which attributes can I choose in Build A Striker?
items.answer: The game lists Shooting, Speed, Dribbling, Passing, Physical, Defense, Vision, IQ, Ego, and Weapon. You choose one attribute from the player rolled each round.

items.question: How do team rolls work in Build A Striker?
items.answer: Each round starts with a random team roll ranging from First Selection to Pros, followed by a random player from that team.

items.question: Where can I find Build A Striker codes?
items.answer: The developer directs players to the game’s community server for codes and updates. Check the official Roblox experience and Wild Card. group for announcements.
